title: Review complete mixed-layer propagation and the explicit all-rank majorant
body:

No analytic propagation gap was found under the named finite identities, numerical margin premises and uniform interval estimate. The source already proves this theorem; this adds external review, not a new exponent or onset.

The reviewed conclusion for the exact default-height raw-p7 scalar recurrence is:

    s=99739/100000; G0=2*2^(10^12)+2; N0=121*5^G0,
    L(n)<=N0^(1-s)*n^s for every integer n>=1.

The review derives the `J/A=1-q` normalization and full leaf coefficient; half-open Stieltjes bounds; the first 3001 mixed layers; complete middle layers and missing infinite geometric weight; zero-paid-letter end layers without LLT; both the atomic leaf tail and Lebesgue tail; every floor offset; and conservation-to-linear-to-power strong induction. Total loss is below `1564.2010002<1600`, so the inherited `D_full>40000` gives `D_N/F_G>38400>0`. Three component derivations and an assembled adversarial review display the arguments and limits. Agreement between review roles is not substituted for proof.

A short hand certificate supplies the tail comparisons: `exp(3)>89641/4480>20` and `exp(3/2)>5/2` imply `exp(36)>10^15` and `exp(37.5)>10^16`. Written controls expose omitted normalization/geometric weight, a second terminal cap, lost endpoint/Stieltjes terms, and invalid global monotonicity or shift-uniform flattening. For example, the inherited rule at N=121 retains 448 terminal-rank-48 exits despite a base cap of one. These are unexecuted hand arguments, not numerical tests or counterexamples to the stated theorem.

Inherited premises remain explicit: actual Flow/mirror/conservation/census/rank realization; finite q/J/tau/c_sigma and complete margin certification; the earlier uniform local-limit estimate and classical approximation.
